result.summary: Found 1 major issue: an invalid delivery price rendered as '€NaN' on a restaurant card.

issues.description: Under 'Fastest near you', the Smash Bros Burgers card displays '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid delivery fee, while neighboring cards show '€0.90 delivery' and '€1.90 delivery'. This indicates a failed price value/format being rendered to the user.
issues.suggestion: Fix the delivery-fee data/parsing for this restaurant so a valid formatted price (e.g. '€1.90 delivery') is shown, and add a fallback/hide the fee field when the value is missing or non-numeric instead of rendering NaN.
